labels.t1:
Try phase: freeze the
bank funds

Confirm phase

1. Insert data into
its own database
2. Call Bank B's API,
deduct funds
3. Call Bank C's API,
transfer funds

Cancel phase: roll back

Add the amount deducted
from Bank B back to it
labels._desc: A user calls System A, which writes to its own database and calls the APIs of Bank B and Bank C, each operating on its own database; the left side explains the Try, Confirm and Cancel phases.
